dogecoin.text: People who had $10 in #dogecoin now have $20 on Robinhood be like: https://t.co/t4rzDOWIsg

Just so you know...you don't actually own #Dogecoin #Doge on Robinhood. You don't even own a stock of it.

So if you're going to get serious about owning a crypto, do it somewhere you can actually have a wallet and own the assets.

Also, you won't get locked from selling spikes.
